configuration.analytic_value: J(b)=(b-cost)*sum[n=1..K] exp[-(rho+cancel_rate)*(n-1)*d]*H_(rho+cancel_rate)(T-(n-1)*d,n*b); terms with nonpositive remaining time are zero; STOP has J=0.
configuration.bootstrap: Resample paired complete context clusters within each (fit_seed,stratum); retain all arms and repeats together; then apply the registered equal weights. Fits are treated as frozen, not as a population sample of fitted networks.
configuration.configuration: Before confirmation, bind the runner's complete fixed/ordinary/planner configuration, searches, selected parameters, context hashes and cost accounting to the source/model freeze. Training and development may not inspect confirmation.
configuration.context_rng: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([split_seed_base, fit_seed])); serialize and hash generated contexts
configuration.cross_stratum_gate: Additionally require all six stratum-specific adjusted lower bounds above 0.005 before claiming advantage in all three strata.
configuration.episode_contract: One constant threshold b per episode. Each hit pays b-cost, resets voltage to zero and starts refractory duration d. Stop after integer budget K hits, global cancellation, or physical horizon T. Cancellation remains active during both active and refractory phases; discount rho is separate.
configuration.family_members: Two pooled primary contrasts and each of those contrasts in each of three strata.
configuration.gate: Both pooled Bonferroni-adjusted empirical lower bounds exceed 0.005 and all three per-fit-seed pooled means are positive for both contrasts.

fixed_and_value.claim: Numerical grid/refinement planner in the registered constant-threshold family, not a certified global QVI optimum.
fixed_and_value.refine: Bounded scalar optimization around every interior local grid maximum; retain grid points, both endpoints and STOP.

implementation_configuration.ordinary_features: Standardize all eight inputs using training means and standard deviations; replace standard deviations <=1e-12 by one. Use intercept, all linear terms, and all products z_i*z_j for i<=j.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_optimizer: L-BFGS-B with analytic J derivative; minimize negative mean training J plus ridge times squared nonintercept weights.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_selection: Highest mean development J among the three predeclared initializations; report every candidate, including unsuccessful convergence statuses.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_threshold: b=cost+(upper_bound-cost)*sigmoid(features dot weights); current registered costs lie strictly between threshold bounds.
implementation_configuration.parameter_accounting: Report stored coefficients, nonzero feature columns and feature rank; constant discount and its centered interactions do not create active capacity.

configuration.information: Same public state, dynamics estimate, cost, deadline, budget, legal actions, guard, and continuation contract for every arm.
configuration.limits: Small-sample empirical intervals are conditional on frozen fits and are not population coverage guarantees; descriptive analytic-J comparisons alone do not satisfy the executed-utility gate.
configuration.optimization: Fixed learns one b from training contexts. Ordinary context threshold directly optimizes the same J using all public context features without value-planner labels. Value threshold maximizes J for the current context. Record the complete searches and all objective evaluations.
configuration.ordinary_control: The ordinary threshold must actually consume cost/deadline/budget when the value threshold consumes them; a constant learned distance is not the only strong control.
configuration.pairing: Same context and named noise stream for all arms; no claim of identical continuous Brownian paths across different thresholds. Preserve all 64 repeats inside the context cluster.
configuration.parameter_counts: Report active counts and controller classes; do not pad the fixed arm with unused parameters.
configuration.pooled_weighting: Equal weight to each of the three strata, then equal weight to each of the three fitted seeds.
configuration.primary_measure: Actual subsequent net task utility under the shared execution contract
configuration.realized_value: sum of exp(-rho*actual_hit_time)*(b-cost) over executed hits before horizon and cancellation, capped at K
configuration.stratum_assignment: Assign in the declared order by example_index modulo 3; any remainder belongs to earlier strata.

implementation_configuration.ordinary_features: standardized full quadratic of all eight public inputs
implementation_configuration.selection: highest development analytic expected task utility
